name: The Crown of Zantras
summary: Charisma +4 (up to 22). The price: Disadvantage on Stealth and Insight checks, and a hunger to be the one everyone watches.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_faceless_god (the ring of amber).

benefit.text: Rooms turn toward you when you walk in. People begin agreeing with you before you have finished the sentence, and feel foolish when they stop.

cost.flaw: You must be the one they look at. When someone else is praised or obeyed in front of you, you cannot let the moment stand.
cost.text: You can no longer pass unnoticed, and you stop noticing anyone who isn't watching you.
